Figure 2:Overview of the MemOnce architecture.(Left)TheHybrid Backbonestacks linear blocks with memory sparse attention acrossLLstages.(Right)TheMemory Encoder-Decodercaches a trailing subset (1/r1/r) of final-layer states into a persistent memory bank, partitioned into a local short-term window and a sparse long-term pool.
For each incoming input, relevant memory states are retrieved only once and dynamically decoded into KV caches for attention layers.
This enables a constant active memory state for continual inference, alongside anLr×Lr\timescache compression across both depth and time dimensions.

Figure 3:Training and scaling curves of MemOnce as a foundation architecture.(Left)Validation perplexity vs. training tokens under different compression ratios. Even atr=8r=8, MemOnce remains competitive with the Transformer and strong baselines.(Right)Validation perplexity vs. model scale (0.15B to 1.0B), where MemOnce delivers the best scaling performance.
